Can Peguera — Barcelona, Spain

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

El Caso/Barna Diario (2023) reported a night-time shooting on Carrer de Riells — several shots fired at a residential façade, no injuries, shell casings recovered. Police linked it to suspected inter-clan tension in this historically Romani neighbourhood (territorial 'marking', not an attack on bystanders), one of five such shootings in the metro area within a week. No daytime incidents or tourist-targeted crime were found. Sources checked: elcaso.elnacional.cat, 2023; barnadiario.com.

Is Can Peguera safe?

Wandroz currently rates Can Peguera in Barcelona, Spain as relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz at night.
